card.title: Everything Is a Contest
card.instruction: Turn every difference or disagreement into a competition you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My tea's stronger than yours. I can handle it without milk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Same teapot. I added milk so I could drink mine sooner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First to finish, then. I've only got two mouthfuls left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fewest refills wins, then. I can make these two mouthfuls last all breakfast.

beats.speaker: A

mechanism: A converts different tea habits into successive contests and changes the metric whenever B has already won.
confusable: Unlike one boast, A must turn each corrective difference into a new competition A intends to win.
comparison: D19-b exploits remaining tea for fewest refills; D19-a uses a known judge preference after the price tie.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
